name: Unsanctioned AI apps
description: AI apps a vendor has flagged as unapproved: a Reco AI agent marked shadow (isShadow) or a Microsoft 365 Copilot package reported as blocked (isBlocked). Each flag is read only on the vendor's own entity type, so another vendor's field of the same name never counts. An AI app nobody has reviewed is not returned.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND (reco_ai_agent | microsoft_365_copilot_package) WITH
  (_type = 'reco_ai_agent' AND isShadow = true) OR
  (_type = 'microsoft_365_copilot_package' AND isBlocked = true) AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.isShadow, ai.isBlocked, ai.webLink

name: AI identities with broad access
description: AI resources Wiz reports as holding admin or high privileges (hasAdminPrivileges or hasHighPrivileges). These can reach far more than an AI tool should.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND wiz_ai_resource WITH hasAdminPrivileges = true OR hasHighPrivileges = true AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.hasAdminPrivileges, ai.hasHighPrivileges, ai.webLink

name: Inactive AI tokens
description: AI identities and AI API keys whose last recorded use (lastUsedOn) is more than 90 days ago: NHIs marked isAi, plus Anthropic and AWS Bedrock API keys, which no converter marks isAi yet. An identity with no recorded last use is not returned: unknown is not inactive.

queries.name: query0
queries.query:
FIND (NHI | anthropic_api_key | aws_bedrock_api_key) WITH
  (isAi = true OR _type = 'anthropic_api_key' OR _type = 'aws_bedrock_api_key') AND
  lastUsedOn < date.now - 90 days AS ai
RETURN
  ai.displayName, ai._type, ai.lastUsedOn, ai.webLink
